messages.subject: CFI lower bound
parts:
I've simulated data from a silly model (for a class example) with a large sample, in which the baseline model fits well. I compute that CFI = -.67, so it should be set to 0, but lavaan prints its value at 1. Is this a bug?

  Degrees of freedom                                66
